environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed via AWS Cloud Map into a namespace governed by a Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy (applied through EKS-linked Fargate profile with VPC CNI plugin v1.12+ custom networking). The policy spec includes an egress rule with a `deny` action targeting CIDR 169.254.0.0/16 on all ports, applied to pods matching label `app.kubernetes.io/component: api-service`. Additionally, the task execution environment has iptables rules injected via a Fargate platform version 1.4.0 init container (PID namespace sharing enabled) that drops packets to 169.254.170.2:80. The AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI environment variable is still set but the credential endpoint is network-unreachable from the application container's network namespace due to the netfilter DROP rule on the link-local range.

config.runtime: ECS Fargate 1.4.0 on EKS Fargate profile
